# Old Furze

The oldest Shrewish at the bottom end of the warren, with forty years of pickled roots, smoked mushrooms and seed jars in a larder the size of a chapel. He fed Quillbark Hold the winter the river froze, and he has never let anyone forget it.

He is not a fool. To a Shrewish, leaving food behind is how families starve. Play him stubborn and proud of it, telling the story of the long frost with a jar in each paw. Half the bottom end does what he does.
